verses.1: And the angel of God sat down beside me, and he woke me up as if I were someone who had been asleep for a long time.
verses.2: And he said to me, “What do you see?” I replied, “I see a golden lampstand, with its branches all spread out above it. There are seven lamps on each branch, and each lamp has seven wicks.”
verses.3: And two olives were placed on it, one on the right side of the hill, and one on its top.
verses.4: And I said to the angel who spoke to me, “What are these things?”
verses.5: And the angel said to me, “Do you not know what these people are? I said, ‘No, Lord.’”
verses.6: And he said to me, “This is what the LORD has said to Zerubbabel: ‘Not with arms, nor by force, but only through my spirit.’”
verses.7: Who are you, great mountain, before Zerubbabel can bring out the first stone? May grace and blessing be upon it.
verses.8: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.9: The hands of Zerubbabel built this house. His hands worked hard, and you will know that Jehovah, the God of all nations, sent me to you.
verses.10: For who can be happy on this little day, when they see the distinct mountain in the hands of Zerubavel? Seven eyes of Jehovah are everywhere, scanning everything on earth.
verses.11: And I said to him, “What are these two pillars on the right side of the altar, and on Mount Sinai?”
verses.12: And again, I said to him, “What are those two decorations on the golden crowns that hang from them?”
verses.13: And he said to me, “Do you not know what these are?” But I replied, “I do not know.”
verses.14: And he said to these two sons of Hizkiah, who stood on the hilltops throughout the land:
